lines.text: Ziz soars high into the sky.
From a dizzying height, she unleashes a bombardment.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text:
Damn it! She flew off again! 
At that speed and height, we'll never land a hit.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I'll drag her down!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: You do that! I'll take care of the rest.
Rapi deploys her drill and launches it into the air.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: G-gah!
The memory of her wings being pierced by Dark Matter floods Ziz with terror, and she flees from Rapi.
Rapi rapidly changes directions, giving chase to Ziz, who speeds up and alters her course midair.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: A-at this speed, I'm way fast—

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: *Gasp*
*Bzzzzt*
Ziz collides headlong into the vast web of electricity Drake has stretched across the sky.
For a brief moment, Ziz is unable to move.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Nicely done! It's my turn!
Electricity sparks and burst out from the muzzle of Maxwell's weapon.
Ziz reflexively folds her wings over her body to shield herself.
But the rounds from Maxwell's bullets tear through her wings and body.
Ziz slowly begins to fall.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Ever seen a railgun before?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: A-ahh...!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: This is the end of the road.
As Rapi's drill is about to pierce through Ziz,
Behemoth suddenly drives her horns into the ground, scattering debris into the air.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Tch!
Rapi twists in midair, dodges the flying shrapnel, and lands on the ground.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Phew, this isn't easy.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: R-right...
Behemoth and Ziz revert back to their regular forms.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Phew...

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: How much power have you got left, Hero?

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Plenty. About 76 percent, I'd say.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: What the... why do you have so much left?

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: I'm saving it for the final boss.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Hmph! Then I'll start conserving my power as well and fight bare-handed.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Stop goofing around.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Just as I expected... this is a tough fight.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Haha!

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: You guys really are strong.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: I didn't think we would win easily, but I didn't expect it to be this hard.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: So now you want to talk?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Sorry, but we're no longer interested.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Ha! We're not going to negotiate.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: R-really? We're not?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: No.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: ... Because Levi is suffering so much?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Are you both Leviathan's subordinates?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: If she says jump, you say how high? Is that it?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Why are you being so childish?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: You're the ones acting immature. You're not kids anymore.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: That's what it means to be comrades, friends and family, Rapi. Don't you get it?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: If a comrade, friend or family member is acting foolishly, then you need to set them straight.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Instead of knocking sense into them, you're going along with it?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: That's exactly how families turn to a life of crime.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: ... I think we're getting off-topic.
*Bubble bubble*
A black puddle on the ground stirs.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: What's this? It's not finished yet?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Leviathan!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Get over here! You need a good talking-to.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: What are you on about? You think I'll go to you simply because you say so?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Fine. I'll be as lenient as possible. Let's talk.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: No. No more talks.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: What the hell do you think you're doing?!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Do you really think we allied with Liberalio?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Whether or not you've sided with the Offspring doesn't matter anymore.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I've had enough of stressing out over stuff like this.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Y-you are?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Yes. I'm sick of it.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: B-but still...

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Let's just wait and see, Ziz.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: ... O-okay.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: You betrayed us, Leviathan.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: You're a traitor, down to your bones.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Y-you little...! How could I even betray you? We weren't even on the same side to begin with.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: How many chances have we given you, and how many times have we tried to convince you?

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: From where we stand, you've been stringing us along, only to back down at the very end.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: You acted like you wanted to talk, but you were really just planning your escape.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text:
You should have just begged for your life. 
Then at least we might have pitied you.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Beg for my life...?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Haha! Don't kid yourself. You all aren't as impressive as you think you are.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: At least the Commander and I—

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: At least we tried to have an honest conversation with you.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: But you betrayed us.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Is the Commander here?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: H-he is.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Ziz!

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Is he safe?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: He's... safe.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Okay. That's good enough.
Rapi adopts a fighting stance.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Let's end this, Four Beasts.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I'm done talking too.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I'm going to take you all down, along with the Queen you created.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: I'm taking a page from your book and ignoring all the possibilities that conversation could have brought about.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: We're going to make things simple and just do what has to be done.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Fine by me.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: It's easier that way.
Dark Matter begins to spread across the grounds of the white city.
In a matter of seconds, everything is dyed black.
The surrounding buildings begin to turn black as well.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: This is bad! The Four Beasts can move freely through Dark Matter!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Now, our battlefield is set.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: This is goodbye.
Leviathan, Behemoth, and Ziz sink into the Dark Matter and vanish.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: Wha... did they escape?

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Look below!

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Damn it!
*Boooom*
The ground erupts from where the group was standing, and a transformed Behemoth bursts upward.
Everyone is sent flying as the massive horns strike them.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Urgh!
A transformed Ziz emerges from the side of a blackened wall of a building.
Her blackened wings slice through the group, who are still airborne from Behemoth's attack.
Everyone plummets violently, tumbling across the ground.
Rapi quickly scrambles up and looks around.
They are surrounded only black buildings and the black ground.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: ... This is bad. There's no way to know where they might emerge from.

lines.speaker: laplace_p
lines.text: I'll burn every last bit of the Dark Matter here! Laplace Burs—!

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: No!
From the ground, Leviathan's hand shoots up and seizes Laplace's ankle.
Laplace is yanked down and disappears below the black surface.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Laplace!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: What's going o— Oof!
Laplace is tossed out from the black surface and crashes into Drake.
The two of them are flung together into a building wall.
In front of Rapi, a Behemoth-shaped mass of Dark Matter surges upward.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Hyaaah!
Rapi drives her drill into the Dark Matter.
But other than Dark Matter splattering everywhere, nothing else happens.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Damn!
The moment Rapi goes to turn around, a massive claw clamps around her head.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Don't think that we're playing dirty just because we're working together.
*Wham wham wham wham*
The claw smashes Rapi's head into the ground over and over.
Rapi's body lies limply on the ground.

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Oh no... this is perilous situation.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: You don't have any more aces up your sleeve, do you?

lines.speaker: maxwell_p
lines.text: Unfortunately, no. I'm the type who lays my cards on the table from the start.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: You are? Well, that's a relief.
*Crack*
A claw slams into Maxwell's gut, and she crumples.
Leviathan and Ziz rise from the blackened ground.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Wh-what are we going to do with them?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Not sure. Should we throw them in the Furnace? They are primo material after all.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Really? We've never tossed a living human imposter in bef—

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I'm joking, you dummy. Why would we ever do such a thing?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Then, what are you going to do?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Levi.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: What do you want to do?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Leave them. There must be an Offspring nearby. Let's take her down.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Levi.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: You need to decide.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Do we end this or not?

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: We can't keep putting up with them like this.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: I'll consider this the end if I don't have to see them anymore.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Do you really think that will work?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Fine. Throw them into the Furnace.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: ... Very well.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Honestly, Levi... you're hopeless.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: You make decisions so recklessly just because you're scared of deciding.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: What's your point?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: N-no... It's nothing.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: I-I'll move them.
Ziz starts walking.
Leviathan watches Ziz's back.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: She doesn't seem thrilled.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: That's impossible.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Right. If you've made a decision, we have to stick to it.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: You can either regret it or not later.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: Just don't back out of your decision.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: ... Hmph.
Leviathan stares at Ziz's back, then turns to gaze at the distant landscape.
She is surrounded by the white city and the Imitation Ark.
The landscape is repetitive, filled with identical buildings and roads.
Amidst the expanse, a color that is somehow alien yet also familiar catches Leviathan's eye.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Huh...?
Leviathan can't seem to take her eyes off of it.
Suddenly, a voice she has yearned to hear, and deeply misses, reaches her ears.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Stop.
